name: Wyrmbog
summary: Black dragons hold Wyrmbog, south of the Dragonmurk in Dustwallow Marsh. Their caves cut into the ridges, where Onyxia and Emberstrife keep their lairs.

sections.title: Heart of the Brood
sections.body: Black dragons patrol the scorched mire beneath towering bones. Whelps and mature drakes fill the air, while toxic fumes and wild beasts make the bog perilous to cross. Onyxia's Lair and Emberstrife's cavernous den lie within these reaches. The black dragonflight holds the southern marsh, and few travelers can pass safely through its territory.

faq.answer: Wyrmbog lies south of the Dragonmurk in Dustwallow Marsh, where black dragons hold the marshland.
Black dragonkin, drakes, and whelps patrol Wyrmbog. Emberstrife and the broodmother Onyxia keep lairs along its southern edge.

faq.q: Where is Onyxia's Lair located in relation to Wyrmbog?
faq.answer: Onyxia's Lair opens among the rocky spires and caves along Wyrmbog's southern edge.
Emberstrife is an ancient black dragon who lives in a cave among Wyrmbog's rocky ridges and guards the broodmother's territory.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion hunting the black dragonflight, you find Wyrmbog the last staging ground before Onyxia's threshold.
Warchief Thrall's scouts watch Wyrmbog closely. Black dragons nest near the Barrens and Theramore, threatening Kalimdor's fragile balance.
